Who am I?

I’m a computer engineering student at Concordia University in Montreal. I build software across mobile apps, Python backends, and embedded systems, with a focus on agentic AI.

I co-founded LocalGo, where I build mobile apps, FastAPI services, and an AI assistant called Goer AI. I previously built offline macOS tools at CopyPasta, and I’m joining Ericsson as a software engineering intern in January 2027.
